result.finding: Assessed 5 CWE rules in Credentials & Secrets: 0 FOUND, 5 NOT_FOUND
evidence: Scanned application source files for credentials & secrets patterns
No hard-coded passwords, cryptographic keys, credentials, tokens, secrets, or connection strings were found in application source or App.config.

No explicit file or directory ACL assignment code was found; WorkerConfiguration creates configured queue directories without setting permissive access controls (src/Contoso.LegacyBank.Documents/Configuration/WorkerConfiguration.cs:40-47).

Operational logging records job IDs, diagnostic IDs, counts, and watched directory paths, and failure metadata stores sanitized exception information without raw job JSON or statement details (src/Contoso.LegacyBank.Documents/Processing/DocumentWorker.cs:96-107; src/Contoso.LegacyBank.Documents/Program.cs:25,36).
